CLE.week7_result: W 27-24 at TEN (Oct 25). Trailed 14-0 early; Deshaun Watson led the fifth game-winning drive of the season; 491 total yards; rookie WR KC Concepcion 8 catches for 129 yards. RT Tytus Howard left in the 3rd quarter for concussion evaluation (Dawand Jones replaced him); DT Mason Graham briefly limped off (knee/ankle) but returned; CB Myles Harden hurt a hamstring and returned. Browns 5-2, atop AFC North.

qb.backup: Shedeur Sanders (inferred; unverified) - Dillon Gabriel activated from IR Oct 26 and also available
qb.notes: Watson started and won Week 7. Dillon Gabriel (back) was activated from IR on Mon Oct 26 (TE Carsen Ryan waived), giving Cleveland four QBs on the 53 (Watson, Gabriel, Shedeur Sanders, Taylen Green). Gabriel is expected to be a backup, not the starter.

context_notes: Dylan Sampson (RB) was activated from IR ahead of Week 7 and is no longer absent; Dillon Gabriel (QB) activated from IR Oct 26.

Trade-deadline chatter: Browns reportedly not shopping Jerry Jeudy.

PIT.week7_result: W 16-10 vs NO in Paris (Oct 25, first regular-season NFL game in Paris). Rodgers 19-of-30 for 212 yards and 1 TD (4-yard pass to Darnell Washington); Jaylen Warren and Rico Dowdle combined for 36 touches and 223 scrimmage yards; 51-yard bomb to DK Metcalf set up the lone TD. No Steelers in-game injuries reported. Steelers 5-2.

qb.notes: Rodgers started and won in Paris; no injury concerns reported. Took blame for a pre-snap penalty.

TB.week7_result: W 43-13 at CAR (Oct 25). Baker Mayfield returned from a dislocated right thumb (missed 3 games) but was only 7-of-11 for 64 yards and 1 TD (14-yd to Tez Johnson); Bucs rushed for 258 yards, had 5 sacks, 2 INTs, a strip-sack TD and a muffed-punt recovery. Snapped a 12-game streak of one-score games.

qb.backup: Jalon Daniels (undrafted rookie; went 1-2 as starter Weeks 4-6)
qb.notes: Mayfield returned in Week 7 with an extremely light workload; expected to be asked to do more vs ATL. Teddy Bridgewater is also on the roster per CBS (role unverified); Brett Rypien was added to the practice squad.
